name: @eliware/test

exempt.reason: @eliware/test must self-host its test command and directly declare Jest, Oxlint, and Prettier because it cannot install itself as its own development dependency and owns the validation stack.
exempt.review: Review when @eliware/test can consume its published eliware-test command and validation dependencies without self-hosting.
